We require castor oil, cotton seed oil, coconut oil, kerosene oil, mustard oil, 1% soap solution, measuring cylinder, 5 ml pipettes, distilled water, five stoppered bottles labeled as A, B, C and D, stop watch etc.
Take a plastic pipette.
Using the pipette take 5 ml of Castor Oil.
Pour it into the stoppered bottle labelled 'A'.
Discard the pipette.
Take a fresh pipette.
Take 5ml of Cottonseed oil using the pipette.
Pour it into the stoppered bottle labelled 'B'.
Similarly take 5 ml of coconut oil in bottle C, kerosene oil in bottle D and mustard oil in bottle E.
Measure 50 ml distilled water in a measuring cylinder.
Take 50 ml distilled water in a measuring cylinder.
Transfer it into the bottle A.
Measure 50 ml distilled water in a measuring cylinder again.
Take 50 ml distilled water in a measuring cylinder again.
Pour it into the bottle labelled 'B'.
Repeat the same steps for other three bottles containing oil.
notext
Shake it vigorously for one minute.
Allow it to stand. Start the stopwatch.
Note the time taken for the two layers to separate out.
Shake the bottle B vigorously for one minute.
Shake the bottle B vigorously for one minute.
Allow it to stand. Start the stopwatch.
Note the time taken for the two layers to separate out. Repeat the same steps for other three bottles and note down the time taken for the two layers to separate out.
Take a dropper.
Add 5 drops of 1% soap solution into each bottle.
Add 5 drops of 1% soap solution into each bottle.
Add 5 drops of 1% soap solution into each bottle.
Shake the bottle well.
Allow them to stand. Start the stopwatch.
Note down the time taken to settle.
Take bottle B.
Shake it vigorously for one minute.
Then allow it to stand and start the stop watch immediately.
Note the time taken for the two layers to separate out. Similarly take the bottles C, D and E and note the time taken for the separation of two layers in each case and record the observations.
From the observations it is clear that mustard oil takes longest time to get separated from its emulsion and kerosene oil takes minimum time.
The decreasing order of stability or effectiveness is: Mustard oil > Coconut oil > Cotton seed oil > Castor oil > Kerosene oil.
